image_description: A silver-colored, metallic breastplate armor displayed on a mannequin or stand. The armor features a stylized female torso shape with distinct breast cups, a central ridge, and layered abdominal plating (faulds). It has red leather-like straps and lining visible at the shoulders, sides, and waist. The surface is highly reflective, suggesting polished metal.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red material (straps/lining) lacks distinct leather grain or fabric weave; it appears slightly plastic-like or overly smooth compared to the metal, which is a common AI artifact in secondary materials.
The edge of the armor near the left armhole (viewer's right) seems to blend slightly into the background or lacks a crisp, defined thickness, suggesting minor boundary ambiguity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a breastplate/aegis and not just generic metal or costume prop.
To assess the realism of the metal reflections and identify any subtle generation artifacts in the lighting or texture.
To verify the physical continuity of the armor plates and ensure no floating elements or blurred boundaries exist, especially around the straps.

focus_areas: Metal reflectivity and specular highlights consistency
Edge sharpness between armor and background
Texture differentiation between metal and leather/fabric components
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'red' components. In AI-generated armor, non-metal parts often fail to render realistic textures (leather/cloth) and may look like melted plastic. Also, check if the reflection on the metal corresponds to a coherent environment or if it's just noise.
